"Dilithium" was the submission name for the **CRYSTALS-Dilithium** algorithm, which was standardized by NIST as **FIPS 204** (Digital Signature Standard for Post-Quantum Cryptography).

The algorithm was selected by NIST in 2022 after three rounds of evaluation. While the original submission was known as "CRYSTALS-Dilithium," the standardized version published in FIPS 204 is referred to as **ML-DSA** (Module-Lattice-Based Digital Signature Algorithm), with specific parameter sets derived from the CRYSTALS-Dilithium design. The standard explicitly notes the relationship, stating that "ML-DSA is derived from one of the selected schemes, CRYSTALS-DILITHIUM."

**Source:** NIST Special Publication 800-185 (IR-8547-ipd) and FIPS 204.
